title: Sana joins the image models
summary:
Sana joined the image API, mobile model browsing got less cramped, and Trellis 2 took a new route.

Added NVIDIA Sana Sprint 1.6B as `sana` for text-to-image generation through the image API. A follow-up changed how Sana requests reach its generation backend.

Mobile model cards now put capabilities, status, access, and generation details beneath the title instead of squeezing them into table-style columns. README and API docs were also refreshed to cover Sana and clarify the documented `gpt-realtime-2.1` default.

Requests for all three Trellis 2 3D generation variants were routed to InferencePort, with routing tests updated to match.

highlights.title: Sana image generation
highlights.text: Generate images from text prompts with NVIDIA Sana Sprint 1.6B using `model=sana` on the image API. [Explore Sana](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=sana).
